pairs.why: Both hats have the same smooth satin-matte finish, soft cyan rim light and chunky toy build as the real cap, and they differ only by a small change in brim curl.
These are almost identical renders with the same soft finish and lighting, so neither one reads as closer to the real cards.
A's wider, rounder crown and softer brim are a little closer to the chunky, pillowy forms of the real cap and neck pillow, while B's crown flares and tapers more sharply.
Both have the same finish, color and light, and the gap in brim proportion is too small to separate them.
A's crown is a little more even and toy-like, while B shows a slightly stronger glossy streak down the crown, the direction the statue-like lessons were marked down for.
These are near-duplicate renders with matching smooth but not ultra-smooth surfaces and the same soft lighting as the real cards.
Both are equally clean, chunky and softly lit, and differ only by a minor tilt of the brim.
A's crown is slightly fuller and its brim chunkier, closer to the rounded, simplified build of the real cards than B's taller, flared crown.
